say:3:1311116001:1.source_cn: 这只怪物，明明我们打伤了它，可它怎么还能飞那么快？主人...
say:3:1311116001:1.male: We clearly injured that monster, but how can it still fly so fast? Magister, should we go back the way we came...?
say:3:1311116001:1.female: We clearly injured that monster, but how can it still fly so fast? Magister, should we go back the way we came...?

say:4:1311116002:1.text: Wait, where did we even come from? Why can't Chippy remember anything?!
say:4:1311116002:1.source_cn: 咦？我们刚才是走哪里过来的？满满想不起来了！
say:4:1311116002:1.male: Wait, where did we even come from? Why can't Chippy remember anything?!
say:4:1311116002:1.female: Wait, where did we even come from? Why can't Chippy remember anything?!

say:5:1311116003:1.text: Chippy, what's the matter? We came from that direction... but where exactly...? Wait, I'm feeling all fuzzy too...
say:5:1311116003:1.source_cn: 满满你怎么了？我们是从那边……从哪里……呀，我怎么也迷...

choice_prompt:6:1311116003.text: Chippy, what's the matter? We came from that direction... but where exactly...? Wait, I'm feeling all fuzzy too...
choice_prompt:6:1311116003.source_cn: 满满你怎么了？我们是从那边……从哪里……呀，我怎么也迷迷糊糊的了……

say:7:1311116004:1.text: It appears that the hawk moth has the capacity to influence our nerves and senses from a distance, potentially through the release of a toxin...
say:7:1311116004:1.source_cn: 看来鹰蛾能够远距离影响到我们的神经和感官，也许是依靠某...

say:8:1311116007:1.text: No wonder Ludovic said it would be difficult to obtain the blue spiritroot alone... We must find that hawk moth!
say:8:1311116007:1.source_cn: 那只鹰蛾很危险，怪不得柳博米尔说他一个人很难拿到冰蓝灵...

say:9:1311116008:1.text: But where did it fly off to? Chippy's mind is still all muddled... A-choo! A-choo!
say:9:1311116008:1.source_cn: 可是它不知道飞到哪里去了，满满的脑子现在还是迷迷糊糊的...

say:10:1311116009:1.text: Argh, what was that? Chippy's nose is itchy all of a sudden!
say:10:1311116009:1.source_cn: ……阿嚏……什么东西……满满感觉鼻子痒痒的！

say:11:1311116010:1.text: These are... scales? They must have fallen from the wings of the hawk moth.
say:11:1311116010:1.source_cn: 这是……鳞粉？应该是从鹰蛾翅膀上落下来的。

say:12:1311116011:1.text: I see it now. It uses its scales to manipulate our senses, creating illusions. What we struck just moments ago was likely not the real hawk moth.
say:12:1311116011:1.source_cn: 我知道了，它靠鳞粉来影响我们的感官，让我们产生幻觉！刚...

choice_prompt:13:1311116011.text: I see it now. It uses its scales to manipulate our senses, creating illusions. What we struck just moments ago was likely not the real hawk moth.
choice_prompt:13:1311116011.source_cn: 我知道了，它靠鳞粉来影响我们的感官，让我们产生幻觉！刚才我们攻击的应该并不是真正的鹰蛾。

say:14:1311116012:1.text: So it was its scales that muddled our minds and left us disoriented...
say:14:1311116012:1.source_cn: 原来是它的鳞粉影响了我们的感官，让我们头脑混乱……

say:15:1311116014:1.text: Illusion? This means Chippy still got his wits about him! Uh, let's follow the scales and hunt down that pesky hawk moth! Ah-choo!
say:15:1311116014:1.source_cn: 幻觉？满满就说自己没那么迷糊……唔，那我们也可以沿着鳞...

say:16:1311116015:1.text: We will not be fooled by its illusions again. Let's find that hawk moth!
say:16:1311116015:1.source_cn: 嗯，这样应该不会再被它的幻觉误导。我就不信我们抓不住它！

choice:13:0:1.text: No wonder we've lost our way.
choice:13:0:1.male: No wonder we've lost our way.
choice:13:0:1.female: No wonder we've lost our way.

say:18:1311116013:1.text: Indeed, and that tree falling was too coincidental.
say:18:1311116013:1.source_cn: 的确，刚才那棵树倒下的时机太巧合了！

choice:6:0:1.text: The hawk moth is messing with us.
choice:6:0:1.male: The hawk moth is messing with us.
choice:6:0:1.female: The hawk moth is messing with us.

say:19:1311116005:1.text: But Chippy feels perfectly fine! Chippy's breathing is steady, and these little limbs aren't tingling at all!
say:19:1311116005:1.source_cn: 不对呀，满满没有觉得身体不舒服，呼吸也很顺畅，也没有手...

say:20:1311116006:1.text: Could it be a toxin that's clouding our senses? It feels like our minds are becoming quite muddled.
say:20:1311116006:1.source_cn: 或许是影响感官的毒素……我们的思维都变得混沌了。
